arguments.description: Get Adjustment Report. Part of the Adjustment Report APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 20.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: date.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: desc.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint).
